svg.title: From a security alert to a release decision
svg.desc: Six steps: a pull request adds invoice search that builds SQL from user input; build, tests, and security scanning run; the team triages whether the alert is real, which tenant data is in scope, and what the checks missed; the release is held while a credible path to another tenant's data is open; the fix adds query parameters, a tenant check, and regression tests; the team reruns the same checks and decides to ship or hold with written reasons.

g.text: An alert starts a decision. It doesn't make one.
